{
  "task": "Automate end-to-end IT service management workflows, including incidents, problems, changes, and requests, within a single platform.",
  "benefits": [
    "Provides end-to-end workflow automation",
    "Consolidates incidents, problems, changes, and requests into one platform",
    "Intelligently triggers related processes (e.g., incidents generating problem records)",
    "Reduces firefighting and promotes root-cause resolution"
  ],
  "frictions": [
    "Experiences complexity creep due to customization over time",
    "Customization leads to tangled workflows, custom scripts, and inconsistent data models",
    "Simple changes become risky and slow after extensive customization"
  ]
}
